text: 记者在中国人民银行深圳市分行、国家外汇管理局深圳市分局2026年上半年新闻发布会上了解到，深圳已构建起“卡、码、币、包”多元支付生态体系，在提升境外人士支付便利度、保障APEC涉外服务需求方面取得显著成效。
text_en: At a H1 2026 press conference of the PBOC Shenzhen Branch and SAFE Shenzhen Branch, it was reported that Shenzhen has built a diversified payment ecosystem of 'card, code, currency, and wallet', achieving notable results in enhancing payment convenience for foreigners and meeting APEC-related foreign service demands.
